paragraphs: My name is Sam, and I am eleven years old. Our class had a play this month. The name of the play was "The Strange Visitor." I acted as the visitor, and I was a friendly alien. We practiced for a month after school. On Monday, our teacher put a poster on the school wall. It said, "The Strange Visitor. A class play, Friday, the thirteenth of November. Time: six o'clock in the evening. Place: the school hall, at the bottom of the stairs. The play is one hour long."

"Where is the hall?" asked Pat. "Go down the stairs at the end of the corridor," I said. "The hall is at the bottom." Pat looked at the poster again. It had a picture of a silver alien with a friendly smile. "That is you!" he said. "Yes, it is," I said, and I laughed. I wanted my neighbor Tom to come too.

That night, I wrote a short note to Tom. "Dear Tom, Come to our class play on Friday. The play starts at six o'clock in the school hall. It is at the bottom of the stairs. I act as a strange visitor. Your friend, Sam" I put the note on Tom's gate on Tuesday. Tom said yes the next day.

On Friday night, the hall was full. Tom sat in the first row with Pat. I walked onto the stage in my silver suit. "Hello, friends!" I said. The children in the play were not afraid. They gave the alien a big cake. After one hour, everyone clapped. A poster tells us what, where, and when.
text.summary: Sam acts in a class play at school. A poster tells what, where, and when, and Sam writes a note to ask his neighbor Tom to come.
